BiblicalUsage: Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, is the craftsman God gives to work beside Bezalel. In Exodus 31:6 the Lord puts wisdom in the hearts of all the wise-hearted so they may make all He commanded, and in Exodus 35:34 He puts in Oholiab's heart that he may teach.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Oholiab proves that craft is a calling, and the God who gave the pattern also gave the hands and the wisdom to make it.
